decision.reasoning_trace: I filtered the list to focus on actual speakers rather than accessories like cables, cases, or wall shelves. My consideration set includes highly-rated portable options across various price points. I ultimately chose the EDUPLINK speaker (prod_bluetooth_speakers_051) because it has exceptional social proof with over 9,000 reviews and a 4.5 rating. At $27.74, it offers competitive 20W output and IPX7 waterproofing, which provides better value than the renewed JBL Clip 3 or the significantly more expensive high-end models.
